Hi Emily,

Thanks again for taking the time to speak today. Quick recap from our discovery so we're aligned:

- Primary goal: accelerate payments reconciliation and reduce manual intervention in refunds processing.
- Success metrics: 40% reduction in manual case time, 20% fewer false positive alerts for fraud flags.
- Constraints: data residency in US-only environments; SIEM integration required (Splunk).
- Stakeholders we should include for the demo: Marcus Lee (CTO), Sarah Ortiz (Product Lead), and an infra/ops lead (James Park).

Next step: 30-minute intro product demo (high-level flow + relevant integrations) - I can run through the platform and show how Redwood handles latency-sensitive inference and policy-based fallbacks. If you think a deeper technical session is needed we can schedule a 60-min technical deep dive with our infra/serving lead.

Proposed times (PT):
- Option A: Tue Apr 8 - 11:00-11:30 AM PT
- Option B: Wed Apr 9 - 3:00-3:30 PM PT
- Technical deep dive (60 min): Thu Apr 10 - 10:00-11:00 AM PT

Can you confirm which 30-min slot works best and which stakeholders you'll invite? If neither works I can propose other times. I'm including a short post-call notes PDF and our one-pager for the demo.

Thanks - looking forward to next steps.

Vanessa
